checks.name: environment_smoke
checks.cases: Correct fixture passes, deliberately wrong fixture fails, repaired fixture passes.

checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: Original waveform at original rising/falling timestamps; initial unknown done; discard bytes; consecutive packets; all byte values in payload positions; reset during every packet phase; reset pulses between clock edges; deterministic random stream.

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation or a formal correctness proof.
out_bytes is intentionally unchecked outside done because the original specification declares it don't-care.
The contract gate validates structure only.
implementation_reasoning: The explicit original waveform reports at 45ns the packet whose third byte was sampled at 35ns. A report state delays done by one edge and accepts the next candidate first byte on that reporting edge. Completed packet publication uses the buffered data before simultaneous acceptance of a subsequent first byte.
